description:
Bring VANA a goal, a podcast, a training plan, and turn it into something you can actually follow. Then run it, check in, make changes, and learn what works for you

With VANA you can: 
• Turn ideas, goals, and expert advice into practical protocols 
• Personalize a protocol around your routine 
• Adjust the plan when life or your recovery changes
• Review your progress, patterns, and adherence over time
